name: Cache
description: Kernel-mediated key/value cache. Plugins never own a cache client; the kernel scopes keys to the active org and enforces TTL/size limits.

capabilities.name: Get
capabilities.description: Read a cached value by key. Maps to kernel command cache::get.

capabilities.name: Set
capabilities.description: Write or overwrite a cached value with an optional TTL. Maps to kernel command cache::set.

capabilities.name: Invalidate
capabilities.description: Delete one key or all keys under a prefix. Maps to kernel command cache::invalidate.

capabilities.name: Clear
capabilities.description: Clear the caller's cache namespace (typically the active org). Maps to kernel command cache::clear.
